a12.title: Signal Proposal - Allow multisig team to use LUNA from validator rewards in defi
a12.description:
The Lion DAO multisig stewardship team (comprised of Kiruse, Usaf, Llewyn, Bobo, and Speerbot) currently collects LUNA from validator activities and sends 1,440 LUNA per month to ROAR stakers on DAODAO. Of these stakers, two wallets provide 83.9% of ROAR staked in Lion DAO: the Eris ampROAR Hub and a DAO leadership wallet.

The multisig team requests authorization to end the distribution of 1,440 LUNA/month and instead use it in various Treasury and community-supporting defi activities. ROAR stakers would continue to receive normal ROAR rewards.

Instead of sending LUNA as staking rewards, the multisig team could use the LUNA in various defi activities on behalf of the DAO and its members, including purchasing vote share on Terra Liquidity Alliance to increase our LP APY, conducting OTC deals with partners, and providing it as liquidity for yield (these examples are not an exhaustive list). Any future uses of LUNA would weigh benefits to Lion DAO treasury, liquidity providers, token holders, and Terra as a whole.

Voting yes would end LUNA rewards for ROAR staking and allow the multisig team to use that LUNA to engage in other activities on behalf of the DAO.

Voting no would continue LUNA rewards for ROAR staking.

a13.title: Signal Proposal - Allow Multisig Team to Contribute ROAR on Terra Liquidity Alliance
a13.description:
The Lion DAO multisig team (Kiruse, Usaf, Llewyn, Bobo, and Speerbot) requests authorization from the community to use ROAR held in the multisig wallet to provide liquidity on Terra Liquidity Alliance.

Allowing the multisig team to provide liquidity would generate yield for use in future defi activities on behalf of the DAO and community, including the purchase of TLA vote share to increase LP APYs, conduct OTC deals with partners, and other activities.

The multisig team seeks to provide an initial 5B ROAR in the ROAR-ampROAR LP. Any initial, marginal impact on APY could be counter-balanced by increased vote share over time.

In engaging in defi activities on behalf of the DAO, the multisig team will weigh the benefits to the Lion DAO, individual liquidity providers, token holders, and Terra as a whole.

Voting yes will authorize the multisig team to participate in Terra Liquidity Alliance on behalf of the DAO.

Voting no will prevent the multisig team from participating in Terra Liquidity Alliance on behalf of the DAO.

a21.title: Transfer Galactic Punks NFTs to pixeLions Ops Wallet for Purpose of Staking on DAODAO
a21.description:
Given the upcoming (and significant) $WBTC distribution for Galactic Punks NFTs stakers, and the difficulty in passing multiple governance proposals in a timely manner (GP will be requiring regular transactions from stakers to prove onchain activity for multiple rewards distributions), we propose moving the GP NFTs from the Lion DAO treasury to the active and maintained pixeLions operational wallet. This move is for the sole purpose of qualifying for and claiming rewards on those NFTs. All $WBTC rewards would then be returned from the pixeLions ops wallet to the Lion DAO treasury upon receipt of $WBTC rewards from DAODAO.

Important: we're suggesting transferring the GP NFTs to the pixeLions ops wallet instead of the traditional Lion DAO ops wallet. The Lion DAO ops wallet is currently dormant and the multisig team does not have access to it.

a26.title: Redirect Voting Incentives to ROAR-ampROAR Astroport LP
a26.description:
Summary
This proposal authorizes Lion DAO to redirect voting incentives to the ROAR-ampROAR Astroport LP and allocate a total of 3.5 Billion ROAR over the next 10 weeks (350M ROAR/week) to deepen liquidity and maximize gauge voting weight.

Motivation & Context

Migration to Astroport: The previous proposal for the White Whale LP did not pass. Due to current inactivity surrounding Backbone infrastructure, redirecting incentives to Astroport consolidates liquidity in a more active trading environment.

Increased Incentive Rate: To remain competitive with other ecosystem gauges and attract maximum voting power, this proposal increases the weekly incentive from 175M ROAR to 350M ROAR per week.

Proposal Details

Target Pool: ROAR-ampROAR Astroport LP (Migrated from White Whale)

Weekly Allocation: 350,000,000 ROAR (increased from 175M ROAR)

Duration: 10 Weeks

Total Spend: 3,500,000,000 ROAR (3.5B ROAR)
